answer.summary: No open-source extensions of BigBench with memory-aware evaluation under token budgeting and explicit memory state tracking were identified in available sources.
answer.content: After two plan reviews and a focused search, no repository on GitHub or Hugging Face provides explicit documentation of memory state tracking and usage metrics under token budgeting within BigBench. The evidence gap confirms the absence of community-driven tools meeting the specified criteria for controlled, transparent evaluation of memory-aware agents. This reinforces the need for a new, dedicated evaluation framework designed with token budgeting and memory state visibility in mind.
